prompt: How does the man expect to know whether his adjustment worked?
promptZh: 男方要怎麼確認調整有沒有效？

options.text: The clock will stay silent both day and night.
options.zh: 鐘白天和晚上都不會響。
options.whyZh: 完全關掉報時才會始終無聲，他想保留白天報時。

options.text: The clock will ring at six this evening but not overnight.
options.zh: 鐘會在今天傍晚六點響，但夜裡不會響。
options.whyZh: 轉盤設定正確時，傍晚六點會照常報時，夜裡則保持安靜。

options.text: The hands will move ahead by twelve hours.
options.zh: 指針會往前走十二小時。
options.whyZh: 要調的是背面的轉盤，不是讓指針快轉十二小時。

options.text: The daytime switch will turn off by itself.
options.zh: 白天模式的開關會自己關掉。
options.whyZh: 他要修正轉盤，開關會繼續維持白天模式。

explanationZh: 轉盤設定正確時，傍晚六點會照常報時，夜裡則保持安靜。
evidence: Can we just switch the chime off? / You can, but it won’t ring at all then. Let me fix the dial first. If it’s right, it should ring at six this evening and stay quiet overnight.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Can we just switch the chime off?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: You can, but it won’t ring at all then. Let me fix the dial first. If it’s right, it should ring at six this evening and stay quiet overnight.

vocabulary.note: 鐘在夜間不報時，不表示白天也關掉報時。
